objective: Compare existing pinned CHIRPS benchmark sources to WFP Source Cooperative v3 RNL daily, and prioritize five global publication candidates from the combined citation top30.
ranking_basis: Incremental public access value: prefer filling a verified or plausible cloud-native packaging gap over duplicating maintained public datasets.
Existing validated local conversion and clear provenance reduce work; private staging is not public publication.
Global scientific usefulness and dataset-paper citations, with exact products/versions separated.
Practical archive size, conversion complexity, update burden and ability to validate without new GEE jobs.
Producer licensing and maintenance/version suitability; do not promote an obsolete release merely because its paper has many citations.
limits: Search misses do not prove absence of an existing cloud-native mirror.
A CHIRPS generation or temporal-product switch requires a new identity and validation; historical pinned benchmarks stay unchanged.
This is a recommendation and read-only metadata study. No dataset downloads, cloud jobs, private-bucket calls, exports, uploads or registry changes.
verification: Inspect named repository scripts and actual receipts; distinguish proof from unsent/failed experiments.
Inspect WFP product README, collection and at least one STAC item; compare reported units, temporal coverage, version and upstream algorithm.
Record primary sources for shortlisted candidates and existing cloud-native alternatives.
Retain dated prior studies, record follow-up corrections separately, and commit locally.
